ModDescription: Foresight beta, registry-free installation: screen-reader menus, dialogue, battle information, navigation and bike-race feedback for Chrono Trigger. Navigation: U/O categories, J/L destinations, K repeat, I guidance, P auto-walk, F8 footsteps. Controller: R3 menu, L1/LB and R1/RB categories, D-pad Up/Down destinations, Square/X auto-walk, Cross/A guidance, Circle/B close. Battle: 1/2/3 inspect party member, Shift+H HP, M MP, K repeat. Bike race: Up/Down steer, game Dash action boosts, K or R3 reads status; high/low/middle tones mean Johnny above/below/aligned. See README for beta limitations.
